screenSummary.playArea: The play area has a palette of quarks and antiquarks and a bag that holds up to three of them. Readouts show the bag's charge, baryon number, strangeness, spin and colour, and name the hadron it makes.
screenSummary.controlArea: Buttons empty the bag and choose the spin. Reset All starts over.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Put an up quark and an anti-strange quark in the bag to build a kaon.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows the spin-3/2 baryon decuplet as a triangle, strangeness down the side and charge along the diagonals, as it stood in 1962 with the bottom corner empty. A small chart plots mass against strangeness.
screenSummary.controlArea: The prediction panel sets the missing particle's quark content, charge and mass, then checks or reveals the answer. A switch shows the octet instead.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Read the mass steps between rows, then predict the particle at strangeness −3.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a quark and an antiquark joined by a colour flux tube, an energy bar for the field, and a graph of the potential energy against separation.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose the starting meson, add the Coulomb term, and set the separation with the slider or by dragging the antiquark. Start Again rejoins the pair.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Pull the antiquark away and watch the energy bar fill until the string snaps.

confinement.currentDetailsBoundPattern: The pair is {{r}} femtometres apart; the field stores {{energy}} MeV.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows the proposed reaction, a palette of particles, a conservation ledger and the court's verdict. For some reactions a quark-level Feynman diagram can be completed.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose whether particles go before or after the arrow, pick classic cases from the menu, and clear the reaction. Activate a particle in the reaction to remove it.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Try the neutron's beta decay, then swap the antineutrino for a neutrino.

controls.diagram: Show or hide the quark diagram

hadronBuilder.bagHint: Drag or click quarks into the bag (up to 3).
hadronBuilder.empty: Add quarks to build a hadron.
hadronBuilder.netColor: Net colour charge: this cannot exist alone. A hadron needs qqq, q̄q̄q̄ or qq̄.
hadronBuilder.unknown: Colour neutral, but no known hadron has this content and spin.
hadronBuilder.ambiguousNote: Same quarks, different internal arrangement: both are real particles.

eightfoldWay.omegaRevealed: Ω⁻ found at Brookhaven in 1964: sss, Q = −1, 1672 MeV/c². Gell-Mann had predicted about 1680.
eightfoldWay.contentHint: The empty slot sits at S = −3.
eightfoldWay.massHint: Extend the equal steps down the triangle.

confinement.dragHint: Drag the antiquark to pull the pair apart.
confinement.brokenPattern: The string snapped at r = {{r}} fm. A new {{pair}} pair formed: you now hold {{left}} and {{right}}, not a free quark.

reactionCourt.massCollisionPattern: Needs {{value}} MeV of extra kinetic energy
reactionCourt.spinNote: Spin and angular momentum are not checked.
reactionCourt.incomplete: Put particles before and after the arrow.
reactionCourt.allowedStrong: Allowed via the strong force. Expect τ ~ 10⁻²³ s.
reactionCourt.allowedEm: Allowed via the electromagnetic force. Expect τ ~ 10⁻²⁰ to 10⁻¹⁶ s.
reactionCourt.allowedWeak: Allowed via the weak force. Expect τ ~ 10⁻¹⁰ s or longer.
reactionCourt.allowedWeakFlavor: Allowed via the weak force (strangeness changes). Expect τ ~ 10⁻¹⁰ s or longer.
reactionCourt.diagramHint: Choose the exchanged boson and the missing lines. Each vertex turns green when Q, B and L balance.
reactionCourt.problemFlavor: this boson cannot change flavour like that
reactionCourt.problemBoson: this boson does not couple to these particles
